claims.claim: The committed Decision Packet compiler accepts a matching valid Work Context and Flow Resolution, supports the six BP-3 semantic flows through typed material contracts, and produces bounded, normalized JSON with a packet fingerprint. It rejects NONE, mismatched or nested packets, malformed material, and over-bound content.

REMEDIATION_AUTHORING supports UNIQUE_FINDING and unselected CORRECTION_FRONTIER subjects. The frontier projection carries bounded finding contracts and requires an exact, duplicate-free match to Unified State outstanding findings; input order does not change the packet.

New approved native and direct-candidate REMEDIATION RUN documents retain the exact canonical remediation authorization SHA resolved before RUN creation. Admission fails before creating a RUN when that SHA is unavailable; historical RUN documents were not changed.

SEMANTIC_REVIEW compilation binds supplied prior REMEDIATION or REPAIR material to its retained authorization SHA and correction lineage, rejecting mismatched authorization content, identity, or predecessor facts.

The compiler keeps canonical facts, bounded observations, Executor claims, prior semantic decisions, and Human input in separate packet fields, reuses existing contract validators, and adds no finding choice or lifecycle action. Only the four permitted files changed.
